info.comment: Welcome to Mario Kart: Time Trials! I present to you four different courses to practice your racing skills. You also get three complimentary Mushrroms per race, so use those wisely. (With the Space Bar.)If you seem to get stuck on a wall while racing, shame on you! Get off our wall!!! Anyways, just turn around until the entire front bumper is off the ledge, including the wheels, and accelerate. You should be able to move forward. If you find yourself wandering aimlessly, please restart the game.Please tell us your times, along with the course it was completed on. Also, Love-its are appreciated.
